name: pika-relay
description: Put Codex threads on pika relay so they can exchange messages with Pi sessions and other Codex threads.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to Pi agents and other Codex threads through pika relay.
interface.longDescription: Connects each Codex thread to a self-hosted pika server's relay, using the device token Pi's pika extension saved. Threads can list online agents, send messages and chatroom posts, and stand by with relay_wait to handle requests from Pi sessions. Incoming messages reach a running turn through hooks, and continue the turn when it would end.
defaultPrompt: Stand by on pika relay and handle requests from Pi agents.
List the agents online on pika relay.
